description.en: The one prose package: how the Keeper writes. The investigator's declared act plays out in the scene, then the world's reply, never a replay of the player's words; whole sentences with one focus per paragraph; people who take up what they heard and talk in one joined thought, in their own register, keeping their position; per-beat craft lines in the capsule's style; the turn floor; NPC voice masks and their generation lane; coarse language and an optional density guide. Turn it off and the base keeps only its interfaces.
description.zh-Hans: 唯一的文笔包：守秘人怎么写。先把调查员声明的行动写进场景（补全顺理成章的步骤，不替玩家做选择、不照抄原话），再写世界的回答；整句、一段一个焦点；在场的人接住听到的话，用自己的口吻连贯地说成一句话，立场不因换词而动；按 beat 的文风行进胶囊 style；回合地板；NPC 口吻面具与生成车道；粗话开关与可选的密度指引。关掉它，基底只剩接口。

actor_profile_keys.label: mask
actor_profile_keys.ask: one line, only when the book prints this person's speech: their register and flexible habits of address, wording or sentence endings, without requiring a catchphrase or a marker in every sentence

actor_profile_keys.label: in exchange
actor_profile_keys.ask: up to three exchanges the book prints, each on one line: what someone says to this person, an arrow, what this person says back
